verdict.rationale: Opting out of usage tracking is a fair privacy question for an online legal-services platform with a web dashboard, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics or cookie controls, privacy settings, or any opt-out mechanism. The llms.txt probe covers guidance for AI crawlers, not user tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
